283264075.description:
Natural Geode Specimen Lot - 7 Pieces
Quartz Crystal Mineral Specimens
Rough Natural Formations
This collection features seven natural geode and crystal specimens displaying varied geological crystalline formations. Geodes form within hollow cavities of sedimentary or volcanic host rock through mineral-rich precipitation over geologic time. This lot showcases diverse textures, hollow vugs lined with sparkling quartz druse, and rugged weathered exterior rinds ideal for geological study, education, or natural specimen display.
Items Included:
Large open geode half with prominent central cavity of quartz crystals
Open geode specimen displaying deep crystal-lined hollow pocket
Natural crystalline cluster fragment with exposed quartz points
Rounded geode nodule with textured outer host rock matrix
Miniature hollow geode with druzy crystal interior
Matrix rock specimen section with exposed crystalline pocket
Geode half featuring translucent to white quartz crystal cavity lining
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in rough, raw condition. All pieces retain their natural mineral surfaces, crystalline formations, and outer matrix without modern lapidary polishing. Natural earth dust, minor fracturing, and rough exterior edges inherent to raw mineral specimens.
